newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Ho Wah Genting agrees possible takeover.
newsitem.headline: Ho Wah Genting agrees possible takeover.

text.p: Precision engineering service firm Ho Wah Genting International Ltd said on Monday it had agreed a deal which could lead to the takeover of the company by Singapore-based Bariston Investments Pte Ltd.

Ho Wah Genting said in a statement it had agreed a call and put option agreement on July 3 which would result in Bariston buying 8.08 million shares, or 26 percent of the company, subject to approval by various parties, including Ho Wah Genting's shareholders.
Bariston already owns 4.71 million Ho Wah Genting shares and if the call and put options were exercised, this would rise to 12.80 million, or 41 percent of the company, it said.
Under Singapore rules, this would oblige Bariston to make a general offer for the shares in the company not already owned by it or its allies.
The takeover offer price would be at Singapore $1.31 per share, equivalent to the highest price paid by Bariston over the last 12 months, it said.
At 0815 GMT Ho Wah Genting's shares were trading at S$1.18, up two cents.
